lines.text: It’s capstone time! Today you will use AI to plan a campaign that helps your community.
Choose something you can see around you, like wasting water, plastic litter or road safety near school.
A good problem is real, local and something people can help with.
Ask AI to explain the problem and suggest actions people can take.
Then check every fact and number in two trusted sources, like your textbook or a government site.
If you cannot verify a fact, do not use it.
Make a poster with one clear message and three simple actions.
Write a 30-second video script with a hook, the problem, the actions and a call to action.
Before you share, check your facts, remove personal information, and make sure there are no fake images of real people.
Label any AI help clearly, because responsible creators check before they share.
The learner gives the AI a role and asks for simple explanations and easy actions.
A smart extra request: ask the AI which facts you should double-check.
The AI gave a very exact, very shocking number, but where did it come from?
We searched two trusted sources and could not confirm it, so it stays off our poster.
Only use numbers you have verified, and write down where you found them.
In Canva, make a poster with one big message, three actions and your sources at the bottom.
Then write a 30-second script with a hook, the problem, the actions and a call to action.
Before you present, tick every item on the responsible-AI checklist.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
